svg.title: Several chunks processed at once
svg.desc: Four workers, drawn as turning wheels, each take a different chunk of the input image together with a thin border borrowed from its neighbours (the halo). They process the four chunks at the same time, trim the border, and send the results two ways: the processed chunk goes back into its place in the output image grid (the chunk assembly), and its numbers become a new row of a growing results table (the result assembly). Row by row the whole image is done.
